## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

List checks run and any limitations. Add a regression test for behavior changes.

- [ ] Relevant tests and type checks pass.
- [ ] User-facing docs and changelog are updated where needed.
- [ ] Breaking changes, if any, include migration guidance.
- [ ] For release PRs: notes link feature/fix PRs, credit authors, and identify
      first-time contributors per [the release guide](https://github.com/Epsirom/braid/blob/main/docs/releasing.md#release-notes-and-contributor-credit).
